sources.title: Qwen3-Reranker — FuriosaAI Developer Center 2026.3.0 documentation
sources.snippet: FuriosaAI publishes pre-compiled builds of the Qwen3-Reranker models under the furiosa-ai organization on the Hugging Face Hub, each shipping a Furiosa Executable Bundle (FXB) for running it on FuriosaAI RNGD with Furiosa-LLM. For the related embedding model see Qwen3-Embedding; for the dense Qwen3 chat models see Qwen3 (dense). Variants #

sources.title: Qwen3 Reranker 8B: Specs, Hardware & Live AI Battle | ModelVault
sources.snippet: Qwen3 Reranker 8B is a high-dimensional text embedding and semantic retrieval model developed by Furiosa Ai. Tailored for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector database indexing, semantic similarity matching, and cross-lingual passage re-ranking.

sources.title: Qwen3 (dense) — FuriosaAI Developer Center 2026.3.0 documentation
sources.snippet: The simplest way to serve a model is to pass its furiosa-ai/<repo> identifier. Qwen3 dense models are hybrid reasoning models, so add --reasoning-parser qwen3 to have the thinking content parsed into a separate field (see Reasoning below):
